decision.title: Node constructors in the evaluator (packet )
decision.summary: Each node constructor makes its own self-destroying arena tree and copies nested constructed nodes into it, with the listed content convention, name checks, fixed construction modes and base URIs.

body.p: . src/evaluator_construct.c evaluates the seven constructor kinds and SHALLOW_COPY (, ).

item.p: One tree per constructed node. Each constructor makes a new arena tree in the item heap's memory that destroys itself with its last reference (as fn:json-to-xml); a nested constructor's node is a tree of its own that the enclosing constructor copies with sxml_tree_builder_copy_node. So a constructor's step only waits for its content value and then does leaf work (no C recursion, ); copying costs one evaluation step per copied node, each content item one (). The arena tree gets the evaluation's error record: it reports only while events are sent, inside the step.

Content convention for lowering (3.9, 4.x). A content expression of kind SEQUENCE lists the enclosed expressions and literal text of a direct constructor, one atom each, read directly (not pushed); atomic items are joined by spaces only within one atom (<c>{1}{2}</c> is "12", XQuery 4.0, 4.12.1.3). Any other content expression (an ATOM, a LET...) is one enclosed expression: a computed constructor's whose value is a SEQUENCE must be bound to a slot first. Arrays are flattened with an explicit stack of content frames; JNodes add their atomized value; function items are XQTY0105.

Names. The name atom holds an xs:QName (used as it is, prefix kept) or an xs:string, xs:untypedAtomic or xs:anyURI: trimmed, Q{uri}local, Q{uri}prefix:local or a lexical QName resolved with the unit's static namespaces (prefix 0 = default element namespace, elements only); XQDY0074 otherwise, XPTY0004 for another type or not exactly one item. XQDY0096 and XQDY0044 are checked here for every name; an attribute in a namespace without a prefix gets xml or ns0. PI targets XQDY0041 (any non-NCName string, as QT4 expects), XQDY0064, XQDY0026; comments XQDY0072; namespace prefixes XQDY0074, URIs XPTY0004 (not one string), XQDY0101 from the builder. Written namespace bindings (the namespace_bindings run) are sent after the start event: lowering should give a direct constructor's own declarations (enclosing ones are inherited through the copy while copy-namespaces is inherit).

Modes fixed for now: construction strip (xs:untyped, xs:untypedAtomic), copy-namespaces preserve, inherit; ELEMENT and DOCUMENT follow XQuery (duplicate attributes XQDY0025, XQTY0024, XPTY0004 for attributes in a document), SHALLOW_COPY follows XSLT 4.0 5.7.1 (later duplicates replace, XTDE0410, XTDE0420, XTDE0450, XTTE3180 for more than one item; element namespaces copied). construction_flags and name_namespaces select the other modes ().

Base URIs: elements get the static base URI as their tree's base URI (sxml_arena_tree_configuration.base_uri, ), documents through their start event; attributes, text, comments and PIs have none (QT4 fn-base-uri-5 to -7).
Deviation: text {""} gives the empty sequence, not an empty text node: the arena tree drops empty text (). Inside a constructor the two are the same (the empty text node is deleted).
